description: Source code for a custom Android View and its internal thread managing a simple LunarLander game, including physics, rendering, and input handling.

classes.name: LunarView
classes.description: Custom Android SurfaceView handling rendering, input, and game state for LunarLander.

classes.name: LunarThread
classes.description: Inner thread class managing game physics, rendering, and state updates for LunarLander.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes game parameters based on difficulty and starts the game.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the game physics and rendering.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores game state from a Bundle.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main game loop executing physics updates and drawing.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves current game state into a Bundle.

methods.name: setFiring
methods.description: Sets whether the lander's engine is firing.

methods.name: setRunning
methods.description: Controls whether the game thread should run.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current game state (READY, RUNNING, PAUSE, etc.).

methods.name: setSurfaceSize
methods.description: Updates surface dimensions and rescales background.

methods.name: doKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key press events for game controls.

methods.name: doKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key release events for game controls.

methods.name: doDraw
methods.description: Renders game visuals onto the Canvas.

methods.name: updatePhysics
methods.description: Calculates new position, velocity, and game state based on physics.
